AppDev.title: App Development
AppDev.subtitle: Here I document my personal journey in app development – from the first idea to the finished app.
AppDev.intro: I had wanted to build my own app for a long time. I find app development fascinating, and I wanted one app that brings everyday tools together instead of 20 separate apps.

chorez.title: Chorez
chorez.desc-p1: Chorez is my first app project. I started it because I wanted a single app that combines to-do lists, shopping lists, and food and drink tracking. Instead of using many different apps, I wanted to build one central everyday helper.
chorez.feature1: Shopping list for planning and tracking
chorez.feature2: Food and drink tracker for a better daily overview
chorez.feature3: Built-in to-do list and task manager
chorez.desc-p2: Chorez is developed with Flutter and Dart. I use Android Studio mainly for simulations and emulators.
chorez.desc-p3: My goal is a clean, intuitive app that is genuinely useful in everyday life.

makingof.title: How I develop the app
makingof.intro: Developing Chorez has been (and still is) an exciting learning journey for me. Here I document the tools, frameworks, and experiences that have accompanied me along the way.
makingof.flutter: A cross-platform framework and language that let me build one app for multiple devices.
makingof.dart: The programming language behind the app logic, enabling clean code and fast iteration.
makingof.androidstudio: My tool for simulators, UI previews, and hands-on debugging.
makingof.testing: I check UI, feature behavior, and emulator performance before moving forward.
makingof.deployment: The goal is to eventually publish Chorez on the Play Store; right now the focus is on stable features and a great user experience.
makingof.ending: Every commit teaches me something new about app architecture, design, and everyday usefulness. The journey continues.
